opening_Japanese_armor.guard: This explicitly supersedes the old generic 52-55-ready opening line. No Chi-He, no 75mm stopgap and no extra tank regiment.

US_landing.first_assault_ashore: about 0840-0845 local after close bombardment and carrier/CVE strikes
US_landing.interpretation: The lodgment is secure enough to survive but shallower and more disorganized than planning assumptions. Stronger Japanese warning/concealment keeps more artillery and enfilade positions alive; US close fire and 12 local fast-carrier decks prevent a beach defeat.

Japanese_ground_tactics.daytime: Use tanks in 3-6-vehicle packets at road cuts, sugar-cane lanes and reverse slopes, with 47mm antitank guns/mines/infantry. Avoid centered frontal Sherman duels.
Japanese_ground_tactics.note: US armored-vehicle losses include LVT/LVT(A)/tank casualties. Shinhoto threatens sides, exposed Shermans and light armor but does not gain frontal parity with M4.

casualties_15Jun.US_center_note: Historical first-24-hour losses were very high. Branch Japanese warning, C2/hardware and armor mix push toward the upper historical neighborhood, while strong US close support prevents a materially worse beach disaster.

night_15_16.Japanese_action: Battalion-scale infantry infiltration/local counterattacks with 4-7 tanks used as mobile firepoints or short thrusts; no regiment-scale illuminated armored charge yet.
night_15_16.result: Several beachhead seams are briefly penetrated or forced to call naval/artillery illumination, but the lodgment is not broken.
night_15_16.guard: The direct Saito/Goto 9th Tank Regiment mass-counterattack decision is held for the 16/17 Jun night gate.
